memberdef.name: replicaset_foreach
memberdef.initializer: for (struct replica *var = replicaset_first(); \ var != NULL; var = replicaset_next(var))

briefdescription.para: Reserved id used for local requests, checkpoint rows and in cases where id is unknown.

detaileddescription.para: Determines how often master and slave exchange heartbeat messages. Set by box.cfg.replication_timeout.

briefdescription.para: Maximal time box.cfg() may wait for connections to all configured replicas to be established.

detaileddescription.para: If box.cfg() fails to connect to all replicas within the timeout, it will either leave the instance in the orphan mode (recovery) or fail (bootstrap, reconfiguration).

briefdescription.para: Minimal number of replicas to sync for this instance to switch to the write mode.

detaileddescription.para: If set to REPLICATION_CONNECT_QUORUM_ALL, wait for all configured masters.

briefdescription.para: Switch applier from "sync" to "follow" as soon as the replication lag is less than the value of the following variable.
Minimal number of replicas which should ACK a synchronous transaction to be able to confirm it and commit.
Time in seconds which the master node is able to wait for ACKs for a synchronous transaction until it is rolled back.
Max time to wait for appliers to synchronize before entering the orphan mode.

briefdescription.para: Wait for the given period of time before trying to reconnect to a master.
